text:
nina_cs: Quick flag 30roFlow (dedicated eval) saw a sharp usage decline overnight (~90% drop). Renewal in ~5 weeks. Can we triage before the AM QBR? :eyes:

omar_se: On it. Any 5xx or auth errors? Could be customer-paused jobs or a connectivity change.

kai_data: Metrics show tokens/hr fell from ~5k -> ~450 starting 2025-11-18 23:10 UTC. Error split: 6% 401, 2% 403, tiny 5xx. Embeds and batch-complete hit hardest. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/nb/iroflow (internal)

lee_ae: I heard from their PM that they flipped a service account to a new key last night and also started a 2-week LexiPilot. They mentioned cost concerns.

sophia_onboard: Their onboarding cluster logs show some rate-limiter rejections after the service account switch. I can push a recommended rekey checklist.

omar_se: Running a targeted synthetic now. If validator caches didn't refresh we might see 401/403 on signed tokens.

kai_data: SQL used for quick slice:

```
SELECT date_trunc('hour', ts) hr, count(*) calls
FROM usage.events
WHERE customer = 'iroflow' AND ts >= now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 72;
```

alert_bot: [ALERT] sudden-usage-drop detected for iroflow. Runbook: cs-triage-auth + cs-offer-cost-safety. Incident ID: INC-IRO-20251119-2

omar_se: Synthetic: 50 requests -> 47 OK, 3 403 forbidden. Validator logs show key-id mismatch on trial validators; signer rotated but validators didn't pick new public key.

lee_ae: So hybrid: customer paused heavy batches for cost, plus our key-sync gap. Proposed actions:
- Omar: force validator key refresh & short TTL patch (owner @omar_se) ETA 90m.
- Sophia: send rekey checklist + restart guide to their infra (owner @sophia_onboard) ETA 3h.
- Lee: offer a "cost-safety" trial: 10% credits + a short cost vs LexiPilot deck (owner @lee_ae) ETA EOD.
- Kai: prep hourly baseline vs drop chart for QBR (owner @kai_data) ETA 2h.

sophia_onboard: Will include steps to safely resume paused ETLs and recommended batch chunk sizes.

omar_se: Patch applied. Forcing cache refresh on trial validators. 403s drop to <0.5% in 10m.

alert_bot: [RECOVERY] INC-IRO-20251119-2: traffic recovered to ~81% baseline 35m after patch. Incident resolved (auto).

nina_cs: Great. Lee please start outreach to their PM about the cost pack and offer a 30-min follow-up demo. If we don't hit >75% baseline in 24h escalate to renewal-engage. Reconvene only if regression. :thumbsup:
